INCIDENT RECORD — SECTOR 4 HULL BREACH

On mission day 214, a micrometeorite impact caused a small hull breach in
Sector 4 near the coolant manifold. The crew followed the standard isolation
procedure, sealed the bulkhead, and vented the compartment before applying
an emergency patch. No injuries were reported. The sector was repressurized
and cleared for re-entry six hours later.

Follow-up: hull sensor grid coverage in Sector 4 was found to have a blind
spot near the coolant manifold; a sensor upgrade has been requested for the
next resupply cycle.
